def: to rouse fully, i.e. (figuratively) to resuscitate (from death), release (from infliction)

occurrences.text: For the scripture saith unto Pharaoh, Even for this same purpose have I raised thee up, that I might shew my power in thee, and that my name might be declared throughout all the earth.
And God hath both raised up the Lord, and will also raise up us by his own power.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
